# mysql-server / cbor_load_fuzzer

mysql-server's own fuzz target `cbor_load_fuzzer` ([source](source/cbor_load_fuzzer.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over mysql-server (mysql/mysql-server at 23e360a7).

cbor_load of the input; on success cbor_describe, cbor_serialize_alloc and cbor_copy are run and their results discarded (the serialized bytes are freed unread).

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against mysql-server at commit 23e360a7 with 1 patch to the library (listed on the project page).
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- allocator ownership: the harness installs counting malloc/realloc/free wrappers (1 GiB cap) and aborts if libcbor ever frees or reallocs a pointer the wrapper did not hand out (catches double free / foreign free even in a plain build) ([lines 38-40](source/cbor_load_fuzzer.cc#L38-L40)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch mysql-server` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `cbor_load_fuzzer.plain` | 296,064 | `6e8cac6fd0955716e0e14755f46f66b70ec69a27d88f90ca67dd2902714885e7` |
| ubsan | `cbor_load_fuzzer.ubsan` | 304,680 | `d8855d7a43c2081835e4b75374f38a40b7196f7a9ec9c112e9e52498c64e0361` |
| asan | `cbor_load_fuzzer.asan` | 828,376 | `3b73d0a69cec89b8d53324d4fefd9b325c0fae7c78de7333b28c31499f20ab56` |
| asan-ubsan | `cbor_load_fuzzer.asan-ubsan` | 838,424 | `e49c6d5e1951627fda22bef36096996027fbd2172a073cf3e763c9cdb3700744` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
